subject: Literature
title: Arthurian Legend and Courtly Romance
description: Learn Arthurian Legend and Courtly Romance in one minute.

hook.text: King Arthur probably never existed, yet his legend shaped medieval literature across all of Europe.

buildup.text: French poet Chrétien de Troyes invented the courtly romance genre by adding Lancelot and the Holy Grail.

discovery.text: The Arthurian stories established ideals of chivalry, honor, and tragic love that defined medieval values.

twist.text: Thomas Malory wrote the definitive English version while imprisoned for assault, theft, and attempted murder.

climax.text: The Arthurian cycle became the template for the quest narrative that fantasy literature still follows today.

punchline.text: A criminal in a cell perfected the code of chivalry.

quiz.question: Who wrote the definitive English version of the Arthurian legends?
